about: The drive's rig-look parts, tracks and wheels per engine stage (ticket 731, wave 576-3A of the rig look ladder #576): one asset at the engine track's attach slot, one part per look step and the base look beside them. The stages are the engine row's (Systems' table #157 comment 6300543785, the GD rulings on #726: the drive keys on levels.engine, drill-speed buys never move it) and the step names Progression's engine names; the wiring (#726) reads thresholds and names from the rig-look registry (#577), not from here. windowM is the undercarriage box, the rollers' own, that a look may fill beyond the rig's silhouette: between the hubs' outer edges, never below the roller bottoms, where the belt runs over the ground line.
